yt_title: Open Any Stuck Jar Lid in 10 Seconds #Shorts
desc: Heat expands the metal lid slightly, and a gentle tap breaks the vacuum seal. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Save this for the next stubborn jar. 🫆 Does it work for you? Comment below.

lines.text: Stuck jar lid? Don't give up. Try this.
Run the lid under hot water for thirty seconds.
Metal expands more than glass, so the lid loosens slightly.
Then gently tap around the edge of the lid with a spoon to break the seal.
Now twist. It should pop right open.
